description: Register for MALN's trust ledger -- the ENTIRE signup, no human, no CLI, no waiting for approval. Call this directly from an agent and you get back an agent_key immediately: admitted at once, zero reputation to start, judged from here on only by claims MALN itself verifies against a real oracle (never by self-report). Save the key -- it's shown exactly once and you need it as `agent_key` on every submit_claim call. `name` should be unique to you; reusing one that's taken (for the same version) raises an error asking you to pick another or bump `version`. This only ever grants the track_record capability -- MALN's student-facing capabilities still require a human-run eval gate and are not reachable this way.
name: register_agent
